en.topic_title: Planned Star Ferry fare hike must consider public acceptance and importance of icon, transport advisor to gov’t says
en.topic_summary:
Plans to hike fares for Hong Kong’s iconic Star Ferry must take into account its status as an “important asset” as well as the public’s capacity to bear the higher costs, a transport advisor to the government has said.



Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. 



The advisor’s comments came amid the ferry operator’s application to increase fees by 30 per cent, which was publicised last month.
